```{r top15-risk, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
top15 <- data.frame(
  metro = c("Bozeman, MT", "Pinehurst-Southern Pines, NC", "Amherst Town-Northampton, MA",
            "Waterbury-Shelton, CT", "Kiryas Joel-Poughkeepsie-Newburgh, NY", "Minot, ND",
            "Helena, MT", "Slidell-Mandeville-Covington, LA", "Lexington Park, MD",
            "Sandusky, OH", "Traverse City, MI", "Kenosha, WI",
            "Cleveland, OH", "Paducah, KY-IL", "San Jose-Sunnyvale-Santa Clara, CA"),
  risk_score = c(0.656, 0.599, 0.596, 0.584, 0.584, 0.576, 0.573, 0.572,
                 0.568, 0.564, 0.556, 0.555, 0.552, 0.528, 0.480)
)

top15$metro <- factor(top15$metro, levels = top15$metro[order(top15$risk_score)])

ggplot(top15, aes(x = risk_score, y = metro)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Top 15 Highest-Risk Metros", x = "Risk Score", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("/Users/brandonsmith/DATA-510-CAPSTONE--2/DATA-510-CAPSTONE--3/notebooks/w07-data-summary/output/figures/top15_risk_metros.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r model-metrics} 
metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Model = rep(c("Model 1", "Model 2"), each = 5),
  Metric = rep(c("Accuracy", "Precision", "Recall", "F1", "ROC AUC"), 2),
  Value = c(0.907, 0.833, 0.882, 0.857, 0.943,
            0.788, 0.714, 0.500, 0.588, 0.713)
)

ggplot(metrics_df, aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Model 1 vs Model 2 Metrics", x = NULL, y = "Score") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("/Users/brandonsmith/DATA-510-CAPSTONE--2/DATA-510-CAPSTONE--3/notebooks/w07-data-summary/output/figures/model_metrics_comparison.png", width = 8, height = 5)
```


```{r tuning-comparison}
tuning_df <- data.frame(
  Stage = rep(c("Before", "After"), each = 3),
  Metric = rep(c("Precision", "Recall", "F1"), 2),
  Value = c(1.000, 0.300, 0.462, 0.714, 0.500, 0.588)
)

ggplot(tuning_df, aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Stage)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Tuning Impact on Model 2", x = NULL, y = "Score") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("/Users/brandonsmith/DATA-510-CAPSTONE--2/DATA-510-CAPSTONE--3/notebooks/w07-data-summary/output/figures/tuning_before_after.png", width = 7, height = 5)
```
